_readme: Seat catalog of the reference council, served by the council_seats tool (docs/REFERENCE-COUNCIL.md, Seats).
families and tiers: regexes on the bare model id (after the last : or /), first match wins.
clis: every CLI the council knows. status supported = the client has a runner; planned = listed so callers see it, no runner yet.

discover: how the client lists the models of one account: aliases (fixed names the CLI resolves to its latest model), models_cache (codex's cache file in its home), list_command (arguments that print id<TAB>name lines).
Live copy: ~/.config/mcp-core/council-seats.json or MCP_COUNCIL_SEATS_FILE; without one the server serves this file.

gemini.note: no runner in the client yet; agy covers Gemini models today

muse.note: no runner in the client yet
